purpose: Define each named Expose/nanoCMS HTTP web instance as an explicit stable identity separate from port, listener, site structure and runtime process.

topics.name: Expose Web Instance
topics.purpose: Define each named Expose/nanoCMS HTTP web instance as an explicit stable identity separate from port, listener, site structure and runtime process.

semantics.identity_rule: Each web instance has an explicit stable logical identity.
semantics.default_rule: A canonical instance named `public` exists with default/reserved port 80 binding unless explicitly superseded by a compatible configuration rule.
semantics.listener_rule: HTTP listener/port binding is separate from web-instance identity.
semantics.site_rule: Site/nanoCMS structure bound to the instance is explicit.
semantics.runtime_rule: Configured, enabled, running and healthy are separate states.
semantics.authority_rule: Web instance availability grants no application authority.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: public instance removed by runtime absence

references.purpose: Web instance binds a separate named HTTP listener.
